citation.sourceDocument: Washington Department of Revenue, no personal income tax on wages (a separate 7% capital-gains excise tax applies to certain high earners)
citation.sourceNote: A state with no income tax is a first-class record here, not an omission: the shard exists, carries a citation, and answers "nothing" deliberately rather than by having nothing to say. The caveat that matters is what a $0 state income tax does NOT mean. A state still has to fund itself, and the ones without an income tax generally lean harder on sales and property taxes — neither of which this engine models. So a take-home figure here is exactly right about state income tax and silent about the rest of the state's tax burden; comparing two states on this number alone will mislead you. Washington levies no individual income tax on WAGES, and Art. VII of the Washington Constitution as construed by the state Supreme Court has long been read to bar a graduated one. Since 2022 it has levied a 7% EXCISE TAX on long-term capital gains above an inflation-adjusted standard deduction (roughly $270,000 for 2024), upheld by the state Supreme Court in 2023 as an excise rather than an income tax. That is a real tax on a real gain and it is not modeled here: this engine is wage-based, so a Washington filer with a large stock sale owes more than any figure on this site shows. Washington also has no personal exemption or standard deduction to model, and a high combined sales tax. AND THAT IS NOW A STATEMENT WITH A DATE ON IT. The 2026 Legislature enacted Senate Bill 6346, which imposes a 9.9% income tax on individuals and married couples filing jointly with annual adjusted gross income above $1,000,000, effective January 1, 2028, with the first returns due in April 2029 — the Department of Revenue states all of it on the page this shard cites. Nothing changes for tax year 2026: this shard's $0 is right for the year it covers, and modeling a 2028 tax in a 2026 shard would be wrong in the ordinary way. It is written down because the sentence a reader carries away from a no-income-tax state is 'Washington does not tax income', and for a household with a seven-figure year that stops being true two Januaries from now. The TY2028 shard is where it becomes an engine change; until then this note is the whole of it.
